تتبادري (form VI)
# تَتَبَادَرِي (tatabādarī) /ta.ta.baː.da.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَبَادَرَ (tabādara)
# تُتَبَادَرِي (tutabādarī) /tu.ta.baː.da.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَبَادَرَ (tabādara)
